## What changed?

Describe the problem, solution and user-visible effect. Link a related issue if any.

## Verification

List exact checks and results. Distinguish demo, mocked, container and real IMAP tests.
Do not claim skipped tests passed.

## Risk and rollout

Describe changed defaults, data compatibility, destructive behavior and rollback.
For docs-only changes, say so.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Tests/checks are listed above with their results.
- [ ] No passwords, tokens, cookies, private keys, mailbox contents, databases or raw logs.
- [ ] TLS, ownership, CSRF and quota protections have not been bypassed.
- [ ] Destructive mirror behavior is explicit and never automatically replayed.
- [ ] Licensing status in docs/LICENSING.md has been reviewed.
